findings.summary: Gold depends on a single silver view with no freshness check
findings.detail: fct_orders reads stg_orders directly; a late bronze load gives a silently short gold day. Add a freshness test before marking gold ready.

recommendation.summary: Add a dbt source freshness check on bronze.orders_raw before gold-ready

alternatives.title: Pipeline-level row-count gate
alternatives.tradeoff: Catches empty loads but not partial ones.
